title: Optimization of maltodextrin–gum arabic–whey protein systems for freeze-drying microencapsulation of young barley leaf extract
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,2129-2145
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00906E, Paper

Elham Azarpazhooh, Yeganeh Sabeghi, Masoud Najaf Najafi, Shahin Zomorodi, Soodabeh Einafshar, Danial Gandomzadeh, Xin Rui
Freeze-dried young barley leaf extract was microencapsulated with maltodextrin, whey protein isolate, and gum arabic. Optimized blends improved yield, antioxidant retention, and stability for functional foods, nutraceuticals, and instant drinks.
